collection.credit:
HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: An old Heathen has been telling the same story at the fire for three nights, and it is not done.

description_variants.description: An old Isolan has been telling the same story at the fire for three nights, and it is not done.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been telling the same story at the fire for three nights in a row, and it still isn't finished. It is about a fish, or possibly a canoe, or possibly (subject.his/her) cousin. (friend) is the only one still listening.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: On the fourth night the story finally ends. It turns out it was about all three. (friend) thinks it is the best story (friend.he/she) has ever heard, and tells it to the children the next night, getting it completely wrong.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) looks surprised, then laughs. "I don't know! I've never got that far." They make up an ending together. It's a good one.
